text:
Situation: Azacitidine has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2020-12-18 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Our Corvale General and Corvale East sites carry NDC 16729030610 labeled by Accord Healthcare Inc. That NDC's SPL set ID 70140e11 names Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473) as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1191818 at the Intas plant ended 2022-12-02 and was classified OAI with 11 observations on sterile procedures and laboratory controls. The OAI classification letter is dated 2023-04-05. An import alert 66-40 for Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited was published 2023-06-01 and a warning letter was issued 2023-07-28 for the same FEI.

Our position: The shortage is longstanding. Corvale East has two lots totaling 75 units with 9 to 16 days on hand. Corvale General has two lots totaling 88 units with 11 to 20 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside has two lots totaling 22 units with 13 to 18 days on hand. The rule-based best option is to transfer 15 units of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East, giving each site approximately 14 days on hand.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 15 units of azacitidine 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories (Sindan-Pharma Srl plant, NAI 2024-08-02) — requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories (alternate lot) — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications; those are for the treating clinicians and the committee.
